layout: one case per line, read line by line: never reformatted

oct_encode.about: a normal to two octahedral bytes, x low and y high, the best of the four neighbouring cells; a zero or non-finite one +z (page-codec-wasm bits/oct.rs oct_encode, the compiler's)

oct_decode.about: two octahedral bytes, x low and y high, back to a unit normal (page-codec-wasm bits/oct.rs oct_decode, sdk-browser cluster decode WGSL)

oct_round_trip.about: a normal encoded then decoded, the normal a page reader draws (oct_decode of oct_encode)
